description: A refined, Parisian-influenced kitchen photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition facing the kitchen island and back wall. The ceiling is smooth plaster with a bold white plaster crown molding at the wall-ceiling juncture — a classical decorative detail that frames the room. Walls above the cabinets are warm pale cream plaster. The entire kitchen cabinetry is painted in a soft sage-olive gray-green with a matte finish — tall flat-panel Shaker-style doors floor to ceiling with long slim brass bar pulls. The integrated range hood is clad in a matching plaster or panel finish, seamlessly blending into the cabinetry. The full-height backsplash is a dramatic Calacatta or Arabescato marble slab with bold swooping gray and warm veining. The kitchen island has a thick marble slab top matching the backsplash, with a double farmhouse sink and a brushed unlacquered brass bridge faucet. Countertop accessories include a tall clear glass vase holding a loose arrangement of eucalyptus and dark foliage branches, a matte black pepper grinder, and a small object. The island base is the same sage-green painted cabinetry. Warm angled sunlight from off-camera enters from the lower right, casting a bold sun-rectangle patch across the island face. The overall palette is sage green, Calacatta white marble, and warm brass — sophisticated and culinary. Warm ambient light fills the room evenly.
